items.title: Common Widgets: Labels, Buttons, Entry Fields, Menus, and List boxes (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Common Widgets: Labels, Buttons, Entry Fields, Menus, and List boxes (PDF 52, printed 48), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Widgets GUI banane ke bunyadi hisse hain. Label screen par text ya paigham dikhata hai. Button dabane par user koi kaam karta hai. Entry field mein text likha jata hai, jaise naam ya password. Menu window ke oopar options ki fehrist deta hai. Listbox cheezon ki fehrist dikhata hai aur us mein se chunne deta hai.

blocks.caption: Aam widgets aur un ka kaam
rows: Window ke oopar options ki fehrist
Cheezon ki fehrist jis mein se chuna ja sake

blocks.prompt: Student ka naam likhwane aur phir 'Save' dabane ke liye kaun se do widgets chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Entry (naam likhne ke liye) aur Button ('Save' ke liye).

items: Label dikhata, Button kaam karta, Entry likhwata, Menu options deta, Listbox fehrist se chunwata hai.
